items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Wild Bill Davis ? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yes, sure.

ctx.x: we all from the time we were three or four years old, we had to go to Sunday School and put a nickel or a dime in the collection box which kids don't do much now.
So, my mother was a choir leader. My father was the bass, the best bass singer, we had two or three. He was the best bass. And you know Wild Bill Davis the organ player?
